canonical_name: LIFE CHAPTERS, energy first: chapters, decades and years read by the energy they carry
construct: Station-only (owner 2026-10-21, L1–L10 A): every unit is keyed by the energy's function (Body, Mind, Expression, Action, Order) and whether the reader's chart grows or releases it, with {el}/{g}/{e} filled by the resolver; chapter lines also by gate and tense, decade lines by tense with a/b variants, domain lines and favours pairs by domain. Year lines and year landings carry Your Almanac's keys and serve both pages (L9 A).
candidate_note: Owner-ruled 2026-10-21 (round 2 L1–L10 A, R1–R4 A, S1–S2 A; round 1 Q1–Q11 A).

units.ENERGY action · chapter.day.grow.coming: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart is glad of it. From your mid-thirties a partner and a household widen your reach, with more coming in and more to look after. You take on the house as a shared project, and the effort shows in every corner of it.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.day.grow.lived: Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart made use of all of it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household was a working concern, a partner and you building something with real weight. You left that chapter with a home that stood firmly on its own.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.day.grow.now: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart takes it in gladly. Since your mid-thirties the household has become a place of making things work, with a partner beside you and more to manage each year. You see each plan through, and the home grows solid around you.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.day.release.comi: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, an energy your chart does better without. From your mid-thirties the household asks for steady effort, with bills to meet and plans to fund beside your own. You share the jobs with someone close and get your evenings back.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.day.release.live: Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart was working against it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household kept you running, with costs to cover and plans that pulled in different directions. With a partner's steadiness to lean on, you learned to measure a week by what you finished.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.day.release.now: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart pulls the other way. Since your mid-thirties, home has run on errands and accounts, with every week asking you to fetch and fix and pay. Each job you let wait gives you back an evening, and the house runs no worse for it.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.hour.grow.coming: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart still wants it. From your late forties new chances keep coming within reach, and the people after you bring many of them. You pick the few that matter and make them pay off.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.hour.grow.now: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart is still eager for it. Since your late forties what you built has kept paying out, with fresh plans brought in by the people after you. You stay busy by choice, which is a different thing from being kept busy.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.hour.release.com: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, in a chart that works against it. From your late forties what you have built asks to be tended, along with requests and ventures the people after you set going. You take it task by task, and the rest keeps until tomorrow.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.hour.release.now: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, though your chart leans away from it. Since your late forties there has been a steady pull to manage, to keep accounts and settle what the people after you ask for. You keep a walk before the day's requests begin, and that quiet hour holds the rest together.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.month.grow.comin: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart is ready to use it. From your late teens there is work within reach and money you earn yourself, while the first things you try pay their way. You find out early that a plan only counts once you start it.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.month.grow.lived: Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart welcomed every bit of it. From your late teens to your mid-thirties there was always something within reach, a chance to earn or a door that opened when you pushed. You came out of those years sure of your own hands.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.month.grow.now: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart has been waiting for it. Since your late teens, work and study have kept handing you things to take hold of, a first wage or a venture that pays its way. You reach a little further each year, and the misses teach as much as the catches.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.month.release.co: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart works against it. From your late teens there are offers on every side, and each wants your time and a share of what you earn. You do best saying no more often than yes, and finishing one thing before the next.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.month.release.li: Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart wanted less of it. Between your late teens and your mid-thirties work came with too many openings at once, each one asking for a piece of you. A friend with a level head steadied you, and from them you learned which chances to let pass.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.month.release.no: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, more than your chart can use. Since your late teens there has been more to chase than you could catch, offers and side ventures and people who want a share. You get through by finishing what you started before saying yes to the next thing.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.year.grow.lived: Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart was hungry for it. The home you grew up in gave you things to do and things to reach for. You learned young that effort gets you what you want.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.year.grow.now: Your Early Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart takes to it gladly. Since your first years you have wanted to do things rather than watch them, building, fixing and saving up for what you want. You learn by trying, and each thing you finish shows you what your hands can do.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.year.release.liv: Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, into a chart that did better without it. Your first home was busy with getting and keeping, and the grown-ups around you counted every effort. You grew up restless, and an older relative's patience taught you to slow your reach.
units.ENERGY action · chapter.year.release.now: Your Early Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart does better without it. Since your first years there has always been something more to want, with a new thing to chase each week. You slow down when an older relative sits with you until one plan is finished.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Career.gr: In Career, this chapter favours work that pays as it goes over work that pays at the end, and you keep more than one thing running at once.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Career.re: In Career, this chapter favours one role done well over several begun, and the depth you build earns more than reach.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Family.gr: At home, this chapter favours shared plans over private ones, and you run the household as a joint venture.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Family.re: At home, this chapter favours plain help over money, and what you give by showing up counts for more than what you pay.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Growth.gr: In Growth, this chapter favours learning by doing over learning from a book, and what you pick up comes from tasks set just beyond your reach.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Growth.re: In Growth, this chapter favours one thing done slowly and well over a fresh start each season, but you grow by staying with what you already have.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Health.gr: In Health, this chapter favours moving through the day over saving yourself for later, but you have the most energy when your hands are busy with something real.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Health.re: In Health, this chapter favours a slower pace over one more errand, but you find your appetite once the list stops growing.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Love.grow: In Love, this chapter favours practical care over fine words, but you show love best through the things you fix and pay for.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Love.rele: In Love, this chapter favours evenings together over plans for more, and you find a partner values your time above anything you bring home.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Mind.grow: In your thinking, this chapter favours a problem you can solve today over a question with no end, and the ideas you trust are the ones you can test within a week.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Mind.rele: In your thinking, this chapter favours an unplanned afternoon over a longer list, and what you see most clearly arrives when nothing is asked of you.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Social.gr: With friends, this chapter favours saying yes to the invitation over staying in, and the people you meet in passing open doors you could not reach alone.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Social.re: With friends, this chapter favours a few close people over a wide circle, and you keep the ones who ask nothing of your money.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Wealth.gr: In Wealth, this chapter favours putting money to work over letting it sit, and what you plant pays back more than what you save.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_domain.Wealth.re: In Wealth, this chapter favours a clear budget over a bigger income, but you rest easier once every bill has a name and a date.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_manual.grow: This chapter rewards reaching. You gain most from the offers you take up and put to use straight away.
units.ENERGY action · chapter_manual.release: This chapter spreads you thin. You hold your ground when your own strength comes first and the chase comes second.
units.ENERGY action · decade.grow.coming.a: This decade brings {el} and steady returns on the care you have put in. You build the kind of security that lets you stop counting.
units.ENERGY action · decade.grow.coming.b: This decade brings {el} through chances that open sideways, a neighbour's idea or a skill someone wants to pay for. You find money and company in places you had never thought to look.
units.ENERGY action · decade.grow.early.a: These years brought {el}, with chores and errands that earned you a coin or two. You learned that effort paid, and the feeling stayed with you.
units.ENERGY action · decade.grow.early.b: These years brought {el} through trips, outings and things to explore beyond the front door. You came home with pockets full of finds and plans for the next outing.
This decade brings {el} as what you built starting to pay you back. You spend with a clear head and still have enough left to be generous.
This decade brings {el} through practical chances, a move, a sale or a plan with friends that takes shape. You say yes to the ones you can hold in both hands.
units.ENERGY action · decade.grow.late.lived.a: These years brought {el} as practical plans that came good, a house put in order and savings that held. You took hold of what you had built and made it work for you.
units.ENERGY action · decade.grow.late.lived.b: These years brought {el} through projects you could finish with your own hands, a kitchen rebuilt or a garden laid out. You liked seeing the result each evening and started the next one gladly.
units.ENERGY action · decade.grow.late.now: This decade brings {el} and the Action your chart wants, with plans for the house that come together and money that goes where you send it. What you built keeps its value. You take on the projects you choose and see each one through.
units.ENERGY action · decade.grow.lived.a: These years brought {el} and a job that paid for effort. You learned to handle money, and it stayed handled.
units.ENERGY action · decade.grow.lived.b: These years brought {el} as a stretch of ventures and practical wins. You took hold of chances others passed over, and several of them paid.
units.ENERGY action · decade.grow.now: This decade brings {el}, the Action your chart is hungry for, with work that pays and chances you can take hold of. Money comes in at a steady pace and practical life gets easier. Each year your reach goes a little further, and most of what you gain stays yours.
units.ENERGY action · decade.release.coming.a: This decade brings {el} as demands that pull you in several directions at once. You keep your footing by taking one task at a time and finishing it.
units.ENERGY action · decade.release.coming.b: This decade brings {el} with more to earn and more to spend, and every gain costs an hour. Choosing a slower pace carries you, and you turn down offers that cost more than they give.
units.ENERGY action · decade.release.early.a: These years brought {el} as clubs, plans and errands that pulled you different ways at once. With a close friend beside you, you learned to choose one thing at a time.
units.ENERGY action · decade.release.early.b: These years brought {el} into a busy home where the grown-ups were always working and counting. You found ease with a cousin or a close friend, though you grew capable sooner than a child needs to.
units.ENERGY action · decade.release.late.comi: This decade brings {el} as offers, schemes and calls on your money from every direction. You say no to most of them and keep your days for what you want.
This decade brings {el} as a busy house, with things to fix, move and pay for at once. You set your own pace with them, and nothing in the house suffers for it.
units.ENERGY action · decade.release.late.live: These years brought {el} in the shape of repairs, errands and accounts that never seemed to shorten. You got through it by doing one job each morning and leaving the rest for the next day.
These years brought {el} through money matters that wanted your attention, a house to keep up and costs that crept upward. You shared the paperwork with someone close and kept your evenings free.
units.ENERGY action · decade.release.late.now: This decade brings {el}, an Action that works against your chart, with a house to manage and money the people after you lean on. Each week brings another bill, another repair or another request. You get through it with help from someone close and a slower pace that lets some things wait.
units.ENERGY action · decade.release.lived.a: These years brought {el} as bills, offers and chances that all wanted a piece of your time. You got through by saying no, and by dropping whatever did not matter.
units.ENERGY action · decade.release.lived.b: These years brought {el} and the weight of practical life, a home to run and costs that kept climbing. What held you up was a friend who pitched in without being asked.
units.ENERGY action · decade.release.now: This decade brings {el}, more Action than your chart can use, with money to manage and a household that leans on it. Each gain asks more work of you than it asks of others. Someone close who splits the chores carries you, and you keep a clear count of what your life costs to run.

units.ENERGY action · year.even: {el} brings Action for a whole year, an even weight on your chart's practical side. You earn and spend at your usual rate, with no big leap to chase and no gap to fill.
units.ENERGY action · year.even.b: {el} brings Action for a second year running, and your practical life keeps level. What you earn, fix and arrange runs as it did last year, without a rush or a shortfall.
units.ENERGY action · year.grow: {el} brings Action for a whole year, reach your chart welcomes. Your effort pays back promptly, as practical plans move at the speed you set.
units.ENERGY action · year.grow.b: {el} brings Action for a second year running, and the reach holds. A plan you started last year pays its way, which gives you the footing to widen it with care.
units.ENERGY action · year.heavy: {el} brings Action for a whole year, more chasing than your chart can use. There are more tasks than hours to give them, but you have a short list and the right to say no.
units.ENERGY action · year.heavy.b: {el} brings Action for a second year running, an effort that works against your chart. You carry last year's list into this one, with the freedom to drop what does not matter.
units.ENERGY action · year.need: {el} brings Action for a whole year, a reach your chart runs short of. Each effort you make comes back as something you can hold, an offer, a payment or a plan that moves.
units.ENERGY action · year.need.b: {el} brings Action for a second year running, a reach your chart wants. What you opened last year turns into steady gains, with more of each one staying in your hands.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.day.grow.coming: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, after years in which your chart went without it. From your mid-thirties, a partner stands with you on level ground and the household gives your strength a base. You meet the years of home on firmer feet, and the floor under you is your own.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.day.grow.lived: Your Home Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, when your chart ran short of it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties a partner met you as an equal, and the household made you sturdier. You learned to lean on yourself first and on others by choice.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.day.grow.now: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, and your chart is short of it. Since your mid-thirties, a partner has backed you as a true equal and home has become the place your strength gathers. You walk out of your own door each morning surer of where you stand.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.day.release.coming: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, though your chart is already flush with it. From your mid-thirties two strong wills share one household, and a partner who feels like an equal is also a rival. With an evening to yourself each week to cool off, you get further at home by giving way first.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.day.release.lived: Your Home Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, to a chart that held too much of it. Between your mid-thirties and late forties home was a place of strong wills and long standoffs, and you rarely backed down first. You got through on an hour's walk before each row set hard, and on cooling off before you spoke.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.day.release.now: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, in a chart that is already crowded with it. Since your mid-thirties, the household has felt like a contest of wills, and you rarely give way first. Time apart for your own interests cools it down, and you are learning that yielding at home costs you little.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.hour.grow.coming: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, with a chart that has long gone without it. From your late forties the people after you stand at your side, and what you have built gives you a firm floor. You grow surer of yourself with every year of it.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.hour.grow.now: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, and your chart has been hungry for it. Since your late forties, the people after you have stood behind you and what you built has started to hold its own weight. You stop asking permission for what is plainly yours to decide.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.hour.release.comin: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, on top of a chart already heavy with it. From your late forties you hold tight to what you have built, and the people after you want a hand on it too. Once you say no to the small fights, you keep your strength for the few that count.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.hour.release.now: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, when your chart already overflows with it. Since your late forties you have guarded what you built closely, even from the people after you who want a hand in it. Passing the work into younger hands spends that strength well, and you are finding that a lighter grip holds more.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.month.grow.coming: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, just when your chart runs short of it. From your late teens, friends and the people you study and work beside give you the nerve to try for what you want. You hold your ground in a crowd of equals without needing anyone to agree first.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.month.grow.lived: Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, the strength your chart had always lacked. From your late teens to your mid-thirties study and work put you among equals, and friends lent you the nerve you had been missing. You left that chapter able to stand up for yourself.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.month.grow.now: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, at a time your chart is low on it. Since your late teens, friends and peers have stood beside you, and every rival has made you stronger rather than smaller. You stand your ground without first checking who agrees.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.month.release.comi: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, though your chart has plenty already. From your late teens, every class and every job turns into a contest, with friends who are also rivals. You win more by choosing your fights, and an evening on your own each week keeps your temper cool.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.month.release.live: Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, for a chart already brimming with it. Between your late teens and mid-thirties friends doubled as rivals and you competed for every piece of work. With time alone at the end of each hard week, you grew tougher and choosier about your fights.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.month.release.now: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, into a chart that already runs over with it. Since your late teens, work has asked you to prove yourself, and you push harder than any job needs. On the one slow day you keep each week, you learn where that strength is worth spending.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.year.grow.lived: Your Early Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, when your chart was thin on it. Up to fifteen, children your age gave you someone to keep up with, in games you had to push your way into. You came out of that first home steadier on your own feet than you began.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.year.grow.now: Your Early Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, and your chart is the stronger for it. Since your first years children your age have pulled you into their games, where you learned to hold your own. You speak up for yourself in a crowd, and a friend who disagrees still stays a friend.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.year.release.lived: Your Early Chapter carried {el}, more of your own energy than your chart could hold. Through your school years you fought for your place among the children around you and rarely gave an inch. With an older relative who listened when you dug in, you learned to stand alone without standing against everyone.
units.ENERGY body · chapter.year.release.now: Your Early Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, which your chart already holds in plenty. Since your first years you have wanted to win every game and have the last word at home. After an afternoon on your own, you come back easier with the children around you.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Career.grow: In Career, this chapter favours a voice in the meeting over a place in the queue, and the footing you find comes from people who work at your level.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Career.rele: In Career, this chapter favours making something over beating someone, but you do your best work when the effort goes into the thing itself.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Family.grow: At home, this chapter favours saying what you need over keeping everyone happy, and the place you claim at the table stays yours.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Family.rele: At home, this chapter favours letting someone else be right over winning the point, but you keep more peace than any argument would win you.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Growth.grow: In Growth, this chapter favours hard tests over safe lessons, and you come out of each one with a firmer sense of yourself.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Growth.rele: In Growth, this chapter favours a skill you build quietly over a test of strength, and what you learn without an opponent stays with you.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Health.grow: In Health, this chapter favours building stamina over spending it, but you gain strength from steady training more than from bursts of effort.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Health.rele: In Health, this chapter favours hard exercise over sitting still, and the days you work off the extra force are your calmest.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Love.grow: In Love, this chapter favours standing beside a partner over standing behind them, and you grow surer of your own place in the pair.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Love.releas: In Love, this chapter favours meeting a partner halfway over holding your line, but you soften once you stop counting who gave way.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Mind.grow: In your thinking, this chapter favours your own read of a situation over a vote of everyone you know, and the decisions you back alone hold up.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Mind.releas: In your thinking, this chapter favours hearing the other side out over defending your first answer, but you think more clearly once you can be wrong out loud.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Social.grow: With friends, this chapter favours peers who challenge you over people who admire you, and you gain nerve from every friendly contest.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Social.rele: With friends, this chapter favours a shared meal over a friendly contest, and what you give up in winning comes back as company.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Wealth.grow: In Wealth, this chapter favours money you can say you made over money that comes as a gift, and the sums you trust are the ones you can trace to your own effort.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_domain.Wealth.rele: In Wealth, this chapter favours an account in your own name over a pot shared with friends, but you keep more when no one else can draw on it.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_manual.grow: This chapter tops up a strength your chart has always run short of. You get the most from it among equals, in teams and contests where you can measure yourself.
units.ENERGY body · chapter_manual.release: This chapter fills you with more of your own strength than you can store. You do best when you spend it, on hard work and on people who need what you know.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.coming.a: This decade brings {el} and a sturdier sense of yourself. You stand by your own judgement at work and at home, and approval matters less to you.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.coming.b: This decade brings {el} through friends and rivals who keep you sharp. You compete in the open and win more often than you lose.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.early.a: These years brought {el}, a strength your chart was short of, with games and teams at school. You learned early that you could hold your own among other children.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.early.b: These years brought {el} through classmates who wanted the same place and the same turn. You learned to stand up for your share, and you never quite stopped.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.late.coming.a: This decade brings {el} as stamina you can build, a daily walk that grows longer by the month. You hold your own on the hill and in an argument.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.late.coming.b: This decade brings {el} through old friends and new ones who meet you as an equal. You take your seat where the family decisions get made and say your piece.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.late.lived.a: These years brought {el} into your stride and your say, a strength your chart had wanted. You walked further and took on what others had always done for you.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.late.lived.b: These years brought {el} through friends your own age who kept pace with you. You held your place at the table among equals and spoke up when it counted.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.late.now: This decade brings {el}, the backbone your chart has wanted, felt in a steadier stride. You take the hill without stopping and hold your ground when the people after you disagree. You decide for yourself where you live, how fast you go and whom you keep close.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.lived.a: These years brought {el} and the company of equals, colleagues and friends who matched your pace. You found a firmness in yourself that had been missing before.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.lived.b: These years brought {el}, a stretch when you stopped waiting for permission. You struck out on your own terms and held your position against people who doubted you.
units.ENERGY body · decade.grow.now: This decade brings {el}, your own energy, and your chart has gone short of it. You stand straighter at work and among peers and hold ground you once gave away. You pay for it by sharing credit with equals, and it is a price worth paying.
units.ENERGY body · decade.release.coming.a: This decade brings {el} beyond what your chart needs, a grip that holds on harder than the moment asks. You spend the surplus on a long walk each evening, before it can turn into a quarrel.
units.ENERGY body · decade.release.coming.b: This decade brings {el} with a habit of holding on to your own way at home. You find a slower answer eases it, and a draw is worth more to you than a win.
units.ENERGY body · decade.release.early.a: These years brought more {el} than a child could hold, and every game turned into a contest. Hours outdoors on your own burned off the surplus, and you learned to win without a fight.
units.ENERGY body · decade.release.early.b: These years brought {el} and a stubborn streak that pushed against the grown-ups at home. You found that an hour on your own cooled you faster than any argument won.
units.ENERGY body · decade.release.late.coming: This decade brings {el} with the urge to carry every load and win every point. You burn off the surplus with an early walk and save your strength for the tasks you choose.
This decade brings {el} as a stubborn streak with friends and with the people after you. You let more quarrels go once you keep an hour each day for yourself.
These years brought {el} piled onto a chart already running over, with a habit of lifting every heavy thing yourself. You learned to let someone close take the other end of the load.
These years brought {el} as a stubborn grip on how things were done at home. Once you slowed your pace, you let the people after you do things their own way.
units.ENERGY body · decade.release.late.now: This decade brings {el} through a firm hand on how home and family should run, a surplus your chart does better without. The people after you push back, and every small choice turns into a stand. With an hour to yourself each morning, you meet the day readier to let little things pass.
units.ENERGY body · decade.release.lived.a: These years brought {el} to spare, and peers who wanted the same things as you. You kept level by finishing what you started and letting the results argue for you.
units.ENERGY body · decade.release.lived.b: These years brought {el} into a chart already full of it, and you went it alone more than you needed to. You learned to share the load once someone close offered a hand and you took it.
units.ENERGY body · decade.release.now: This decade brings {el}, a surplus of your own energy, and it makes you stubborn with your equals. People at work want the same ground you do, and every meeting turns into a test of will. What carries you is time alone at the start of each day, before anyone asks anything of you.

units.ENERGY body · year.core_even: {el} brings Body for a whole year, your own strength at an even level for your chart. You hold your own with equals at your usual pitch, neither pushing for ground nor giving it up.
units.ENERGY body · year.core_even.b: {el} brings Body for a second year running, and your strength stays level. Your stamina and your nerve keep last year's measure, with nothing to prove and nothing to hold back.
units.ENERGY body · year.core_over: {el} brings Body for a whole year, strength your chart already runs over with. You meet every exchange as a contest of wills, though time alone and letting a small point go stay open to you.
units.ENERGY body · year.core_over.b: {el} brings Body for a second year running, strength piled on strength. Each old rivalry you thought had cooled flares up, though a slower pace and help from someone close are yours to call on.
units.ENERGY body · year.core_under: {el} brings Body for a whole year, a strength your chart runs short of. You stand your ground more easily, as equals begin to treat you as one of them.
units.ENERGY body · year.core_under.b: {el} brings Body for a second year running, a strength your chart wants. Equals take you seriously now, while the place you held back from last year opens to you.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.day.grow.com: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart is eager for it. From your mid-thirties home becomes a place of good food and music, with a partner who enjoys you at your liveliest. You make the household a warm place to come back to.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.day.grow.liv: Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart blossomed under it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties home was lively, with a partner who laughed at your stories and a table set for guests. You came out of it knowing how to make a house feel like yours.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.day.grow.now: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart is warmed by it. Since your mid-thirties, home has been full of cooking, laughter and things you made with a partner. You let yourself enjoy it all in these years without first earning it.
Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, an energy your chart does better without. From your mid-thirties your tongue is quick at home, and a partner hears more of your opinions than they asked for. You find the warmth comes back on a slow walk after dinner, when you listen more than you talk.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, in a chart that worked better without it. Between your mid-thirties and late forties you said what you thought at home and spent on whatever pleased you. Long quiet evenings wore the urge down, and you came away choosing your words with more care.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart cannot use all of it. Since your mid-thirties, appetite and opinion have filled the house, and your restlessness has set its pace. An hour of quiet each evening settles it, and you are learning to let a partner have the last word.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.hour.grow.co: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart is ready for all of it. From your late forties, there is time and skill to make what is in your head, and the people after you learn by watching. You stop saving your ideas for later.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.hour.grow.no: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart sings with it. Since your late forties you have taught, performed or made things for the people after you, and they carry your style. You make things for the pleasure of it, with nothing left to prove.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.hour.release: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, one that works against your chart. From your late forties you hold opinions on how the people after you live, and you voice them freely. With an hour alone each day to cool your views, you find they listen better when you say less.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, more than your chart can use. Since your late forties you have spent freely on pleasures and told the people after you exactly what you think. With a night between a thought and its saying, you find your words carry further when there are fewer of them.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.month.grow.c: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart is ready to be heard. From your late teens, the things you make and say find people who want more of them. You find your own way of saying things, and people start to quote it back to you.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.month.grow.l: Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart came alive with it. From your late teens to your mid-thirties you made things, spoke up and found friends who liked your work. You came out of that chapter with a voice people recognised.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.month.grow.n: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart has been waiting for exactly this. Since your late teens, what you make has found listeners at work and among friends who ask what comes next. You show your work before it is perfect, and it lands anyway.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.month.releas: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart pushes against it. From your late teens you want to say everything and try everything, and those in charge do not always welcome it. You do your best talking after a walk on your own, when the first heat has gone.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, against the grain of your chart. Between your late teens and mid-thirties you spoke first, spent freely and chafed at every rule you had not written. Finishing one thing before you started the next carried you, and you left those years knowing which fights deserved your voice.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart has more than it can spend. Since your late teens your voice has outrun your position, and the people in charge have not always enjoyed it. You are learning that finished work speaks louder than talk, and that a day of silence before you object keeps your place.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.year.grow.li: Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart was glad of the outlet. Before you turned sixteen there were drawings, songs and stories, and the grown-ups at home clapped for every one of them. You came out of childhood sure that your voice was worth hearing.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.year.grow.no: Your Early Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart opens up to it. Since your first years you have sung, drawn, told stories and made up games for anyone who would join in. You speak your mind out loud, and people at home have learned to stop and listen.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter.year.release: Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, into a chart that pulled against it. As a child you talked back, tested every rule and wanted everything at once. With an older relative who heard you out before answering, you learned when to speak and when to wait.

Your Early Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart pulls the other way. Since your first years the sharp answer has come out first, along with a wish for every treat at once. You calm down on a long walk with someone who lets you talk it all out.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter_domain.Caree: In Career, this chapter favours work with your name on it over work that disappears into the whole, and what you make yourself gets you noticed.
In Career, this chapter favours one piece finished over three begun, but you are trusted most for the work you hand in quietly.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter_domain.Famil: At home, this chapter favours cooking and making things together over keeping the place tidy, and the things you make fill the house.
At home, this chapter favours a kind word over a sharp one, and you keep the household calm by holding back the first reply.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter_domain.Growt: In Growth, this chapter favours making something of your own over collecting certificates, and what you show to others teaches you the most.
In Growth, this chapter favours slow work out of sight over quick display, but you go further with one thing kept back until it is right.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter_domain.Healt: In Health, this chapter favours good food and play over strict routines, and you recover your energy through the things you enjoy.
In Health, this chapter favours a steady appetite over feasts, but you keep your energy on evenings when you talk less and stop sooner.
In Love, this chapter favours laughing with a partner over keeping things serious, and the affection you show comes openly and easily.
In Love, this chapter favours hearing a partner out over making your point, and you win more warmth by asking than by telling.
In your thinking, this chapter favours ideas you can make real over ideas you only hold, and you think best with a pen in your hand.
In your thinking, this chapter favours one finished idea over ten half-formed ones, but you give your best thought the time it needs to ripen.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter_domain.Socia: With friends, this chapter favours a lively table over a quiet evening in, and you become the one who gets everyone talking.
With friends, this chapter favours a long walk with one person over a big night with many, but you are trusted more when you share less.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter_domain.Wealt: In Wealth, this chapter favours earning from a skill over earning by the hour, and what you enjoy doing starts to pay.
In Wealth, this chapter favours buying once over buying often, but you keep more when a treat waits until the end of the month.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter_manual.grow: This chapter opens an outlet your chart has long been short of. You gain most when you finish what you start and let other people see it.
units.ENERGY expression · chapter_manual.relea: This chapter loosens your tongue and your appetite more than your chart can use. Your words land harder the fewer you use, and that keeps your standing.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.grow.coming.a: This decade brings {el}, the outlet your chart is short of. You say what you think at the moment you think it, and the words come out whole.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.grow.coming.b: This decade brings {el} and a skill ready to be shown, with people keen to learn it from you. You teach, make or perform, and you are paid in attention as well as thanks.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.grow.early.a: These years brought {el}, with drawing, music or games you made up yourself. You found something you were good at and showed it to anyone who would look.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.grow.early.b: These years brought {el} and a louder voice at school, in class and among friends. Someone in your first home enjoyed your stories, and you kept telling them.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.grow.late.com: This decade brings {el} and the pleasure of showing someone younger how a thing is made. You teach with your hands as much as your words, and the lessons stick.
This decade brings {el} as an appetite for new tastes, new places and an evening out without a reason. You say yes to the invitation and come home with a story to tell.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.grow.late.liv: These years brought {el} as time to make things for pleasure, a garden, a quilt or a tune at the piano. You made what you liked and gave much of it away.
These years brought {el} in long dinners with friends who stayed late. You told your stories well, and the younger ones at the table asked for them by name.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.grow.late.now: This decade brings {el} as hours to cook, sew and make, a voice your chart has wanted. The work of your hands finds people who want it, and your stories hold the table. You enjoy what you make without needing it to be perfect.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.grow.lived.a: These years brought {el} and work that let you make things your own way. You found your style, and people began to ask for it.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.grow.lived.b: These years brought {el}, a lighter stretch of good food, good company and things done for pleasure. You laughed easily and said what you thought without rehearsing it first.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.grow.now: This decade brings {el}, the Expression your chart has waited for, with ideas that turn into finished things. Food tastes better and the work in your hands goes well. You enjoy more, worry less and show your work without asking anyone first.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.release.comin: This decade brings {el} with a voice that runs faster than your patience. You keep your standing by sleeping on the reply and sending the shorter version.
This decade brings {el} with ideas you want to say aloud before they are ready. What carries you is time alone with each idea, until it can stand without you defending it.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.release.early: These years brought {el} in a rush, with a quick tongue that got you into trouble in class. You learned to ask before you argued, and the trouble grew rarer.
These years brought {el} to a restless child who wanted to try everything at once. You found the quiet pride of a finished thing, with an older relative sitting patiently beside you.
This decade brings {el} as a restless wish to say everything you have kept to yourself. You choose your moment after an hour alone, and the words land kinder for it.
This decade brings {el} through projects and plans that outrun your energy. You say no to half of them and enjoy the rest for longer.
These years brought {el} to the family table as a sharp tongue, with opinions ready for every topic. You kept your welcome by letting the people after you finish their sentences.
These years brought {el} through appetite and spending, a new hobby each season and a cupboard of half-done things. You found more pleasure in finishing one of them than in starting the next.

This decade brings {el}, an Expression that works against your chart, as a busy tongue and an appetite that spends faster than it should. You offer your view on other people's lives before anyone asks for it. Time alone gives you back the patience to listen.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.release.lived: These years brought {el} as a sharp voice at work, with friction from people above you. You won respect by finishing the job before you spoke about it.
These years brought {el} through a spell of appetite and easy spending. With friends who kept you honest, you held on to the fun without losing your footing.
units.ENERGY expression · decade.release.now: This decade brings {el}, more Expression than your chart can use, a sharp voice and little patience for rules you did not write. You say what others only think, and it costs you goodwill. You keep the friendships that matter by saying a thing once and letting it rest.

units.ENERGY expression · year.even: {el} brings Expression for a whole year, output your chart can take or leave. You say what you mean at the length you mean it, and your appetites keep their ordinary size.
units.ENERGY expression · year.even.b: {el} brings Expression for a second year running, neither pushing nor holding back your chart. Your voice and your appetites stay where last year left them, as the making you do fits the hours you have.
units.ENERGY expression · year.grow: {el} brings Expression for a whole year, a voice your chart welcomes. What you make and say lands where you aim it, with pleasure in the making as well as the result.
units.ENERGY expression · year.grow.b: {el} brings Expression for a second year running, and the outlet stays open. A skill you kept for pleasure begins to pay its way, while new work comes faster than last year's did.

units.ENERGY expression · year.need: {el} brings Expression for a whole year, an outlet your chart runs short of. Words you held back find their way out, while what you make starts to be seen beyond your own circle.
units.ENERGY expression · year.need.b: {el} brings Expression for a second year running, an outlet your chart wants. Work you showed last year reaches people who were not there the first time, and your voice gets steadier with use.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.day.grow.coming: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart is ready for it. From your mid-thirties, home becomes a place to rest and think, with a partner who cares for you as much as you care for them. You recover there from whatever the rest of life asks.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.day.grow.lived: Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart took all it could. Between your mid-thirties and late forties a partner looked after you, and home became the quiet place where you read and recovered. You left those years able to say what you need without apology.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.day.grow.now: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart is grateful for it. Since your mid-thirties a partner has been your sounding board and home your place to read, rest and recover. You think things through out loud now, and the answers come quicker.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.day.release.coming: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, an energy your chart does better without. From your mid-thirties, a careful partner and a quiet household make it easy to think things over too long. You keep the days moving by finishing one small thing before you plan the next.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.day.release.lived: Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, though your chart worked better without it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household was soft and settled, with every choice thought over twice. A practical project shared with a partner got you out of your head, and you left knowing that thinking needs a task.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.day.release.now: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, one that works against your chart. Since your mid-thirties, home has offered so much comfort and counsel that your own decisions wait. You make one small decision a day alone, and your judgement comes back with use.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.hour.grow.coming: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart opens to it. From your late forties there is time at last to learn for pleasure, and the people after you come to you for advice. You become the one others think things through with.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.hour.grow.now: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart has needed it for years. Since your late forties, you have read more, rested better and found a patient voice with the people after you. You give good advice now because you finally take your own.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.hour.release.comin: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, against the pull of your chart. From your late forties, the people after you fuss over you more than you need and quiet days pile up. You stay sharp on a morning walk and one job finished before noon.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.hour.release.now: Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart holds more than it can use. Since your late forties you have been looked after and advised from every side, and what you built runs without much from you. You find a role beyond being cared for in small jobs done at your own pace.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.month.grow.coming: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart opens its doors to it. From your late teens, people who know more than you take an interest, and what you study turns into something you can use. You find the people worth learning from, and they find you too.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.month.grow.lived: Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart was thirsty for it. Between your late teens and your mid-thirties a teacher and an older hand at work vouched for you, and what you studied opened doors. You came out of those years well taught and well backed.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.month.grow.now: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart welcomes every bit of it. Since your late teens, mentors and courses have found you at the right moments, and study has turned into standing. You learn in step with what you need, and nothing you study sits unused.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.month.release.comi: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart would rather go without it. From your late teens there is always one more course to finish and one more opinion to ask before you begin. You get going by trying things half prepared, and they work more often than you think.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.month.release.live: Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, into a chart that pulled the other way. From your late teens to your mid-thirties you studied long and waited longer, with more support around you than push. Once a friend asked what you were waiting for, you started to use what you knew.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.month.release.now: Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart leans away from it. Since your late teens you have gathered qualifications and advice faster than chances to use them. You are learning to move before you feel ready, one small step a week.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.year.grow.lived: Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart drank it in. Up to fifteen there were books and teachers and an older relative who made time to explain things. You came out of childhood with a habit of asking why that never left you.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.year.grow.now: Your Early Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart soaks it up. Since your first years someone at home has made time to answer your questions, and books have kept you company on slow days. You think things through before you speak, and what you notice is usually right.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.year.release.lived: Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart did better without it. Through your school years you were looked after closely, and others in your first home decided much for you. With afternoons outdoors on your own, you left childhood able to act as well as think.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter.year.release.now: Your Early Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, and your chart does better without it. Since your first years the grown-ups around you have worried on your behalf and smoothed each path before you reached it. You grow surer each time you try something on your own and get it done without help.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Career.grow: In Career, this chapter favours good advice over a bigger title, and you do your best work among people whose judgement you trust.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Career.rele: In Career, this chapter favours starting before you feel ready over one more round of preparing, but you already know enough to begin.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Family.grow: At home, this chapter favours a quiet household over a busy one, and what you find there is the ease of being looked after.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Family.rele: At home, this chapter favours doing for others over waiting to be done for, but you grow steadier with every job you take off someone's hands.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Growth.grow: In Growth, this chapter favours asking for help over working it out alone, and what you learn from someone patient pays you back for years.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Growth.rele: In Growth, this chapter favours practice over theory, and you learn more from one real attempt than from a shelf of advice.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Health.grow: In Health, this chapter favours resting before you are tired over pushing through, but you gather strength from long sleeps and slow mornings.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Health.rele: In Health, this chapter favours getting up and out over lying low, but you are brightest on days when your body has been busy before noon.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Love.grow: In Love, this chapter favours being cared for over proving you need nothing, but you let a partner look after you without keeping score.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Love.releas: In Love, this chapter favours giving care over waiting for it, and the closeness you share with a partner comes with your hands on the same job.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Mind.grow: In your thinking, this chapter favours slow reading over quick answers, and what you take in from books and patient people stays with you.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Mind.releas: In your thinking, this chapter favours a decision made over a question kept open, but you see further once you have taken the first step.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Social.grow: With friends, this chapter favours a long talk with someone wise over a noisy night, and the few people you lean on are the ones who see you clearly.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Social.rele: With friends, this chapter favours making plans over mulling them over, and you are the one who books the table and turns up first.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Wealth.grow: In Wealth, this chapter favours slow learning over quick gains, but you earn more once you understand where your money goes.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_domain.Wealth.rele: In Wealth, this chapter favours acting on a plan over perfecting it, but you gain more from the first small move than from weeks of reading.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_manual.grow: This chapter feeds you with learning, help and rest. You draw the most from it through slow study and the people who back you.
units.ENERGY mind · chapter_manual.release: This chapter wraps you in more thought and shelter than you can use. You are lighter on days when your hands are busy and one question gets settled.
units.ENERGY mind · decade.grow.coming.a: This decade brings {el} and the chance to study something for its own sake. You read, ask and turn things over, and your own life starts to make sense to you.
units.ENERGY mind · decade.grow.coming.b: This decade brings {el} with helpers who turn up just when you need them. You accept support without keeping score, and rest comes easily.

units.ENERGY mind · decade.grow.late.coming.a: This decade brings {el} as the quiet to learn something new, a language, an instrument or a subject that pulls at you. You read slowly and teach a little of what you know to someone younger.
units.ENERGY mind · decade.grow.late.coming.b: This decade brings {el} through friends and younger relatives who call by and stay for tea. You accept their care easily, and the house feels fuller for it.
units.ENERGY mind · decade.grow.late.lived.a: These years brought {el} as time to read and think about your own life. You understood old choices better and forgave a few of them.
units.ENERGY mind · decade.grow.late.lived.b: These years brought {el} through people who looked out for you, a friend at the door and help that came before you asked. You took the care you were given and slept better for it.
units.ENERGY mind · decade.grow.late.now: This decade brings {el}, a Mind your chart runs short of, as time to think and friends who look in on you. units.ENERGY mind · decade.grow.lived.a: These years brought {el} through study, a course or a training that finally fitted. You gained a way of thinking that you still use.
units.ENERGY mind · decade.grow.lived.b: These years brought {el}, a stretch of shelter with someone who backed you and asked little in return. You let yourself be helped and found that it cost you nothing.
units.ENERGY mind · decade.grow.now: This decade brings {el}, the Mind your chart has gone without, with study and people who look out for you. A course or a good adviser opens a door you had walked past. You learn faster than you expected and rest without apology.
